title: Native canary sender public original, not durable contact permission
$comment: No new cold selector is introduced. Actual generated TLS, native role-4 signer, original process/CA/lifetime and durable precontact authority cannot be represented by a JSON object. Statement22, evidence4, batch4 and HTTP3 share the independent receiver's exact contract. Native proof signs schema ASCII plus NUL plus full canonical Python-ASCII statement including escaped DEL; audit's digest preimage is not used. No network send is implemented by this primitive.
